poc_findings: Throughput: baseline Dedicated cluster (8x A100 equivalent) sustained 380 qps for 64-token workloads with 85% GPU utilization
Latency: observed p95 = 170ms at steady state; p99 spikes to 480ms under cold KV cache
Soak: 72-hour soak passed with <0.4% error rate; occasional GC-induced jitter traced to control-plane metrics agent
Quantization: 4-bit weights reduced memory and cost but increased inference variance on reranking tasks; needs kernel tuning
Batching effects: continuous batching improved median latency by 22% but increased p99 under burst traffic - recommend adaptive batching policy
Fallbacks: model-variant fallback to smaller fp16 model keeps availability but increases per-token cost by ~35%
Observability: per-route token-level cost traces and distributed trace headers were critical to root-cause a cross-VPC latency issue
